title: NSRsmp
description: Not too many strict rules. For example, glitch abusing and combat logging is allowed. There is one, no cussing, that lot's of people would call strict.
body:
**Very random, vanilla SMP.** There's an anti-xray mod, by the way.

NSR stand for Non Strict Rules

IF THE SERVER IS OFFLINE, YOU MIGHT HAVE TO RENEW IT, THEN START IT.
  [Minecraft server](https://freemcserver.net/server/1988244)

#1 RULE: NO SWEARING (Sorry for being super strict!)

### **Banned stuff:**
Xray, Fullbright, Autoclickers, Minimap is allowed if entity rendering is off, Crashing the game purposefully, Illegal activity, Flying(Like mods, elytra and others things that launch you is allowed), Speedhacking(Key word: HACK), hacking, E-dating, Trapping someone in the void for more than 1 IRL week.

### **Stuff that isn't allowed on most servers but is on this:**
Glitch abusing, Combat logging(Please don't, but it's allowed), Most client-side mods, Seed crackers.
